load_hparams_from_json: load hyperparameters from a JSON config file into an AttrDict object
create_bigvgan_model: create a BigVGAN neural vocoder model with configurable upsampling and AMP residual blocks
build_ampblock1: build an AMPBlock1 residual block with dual conv layers and Snake/SnakeBeta activations
build_ampblock2: build an AMPBlock2 residual block with single conv layers and Snake/SnakeBeta activations
run_bigvgan_inference: run BigVGAN forward pass to generate audio waveforms from mel spectrogram inputs
